definitions.explanation: Deeply and sincerely religious in attitude and conduct. Used of believers of any faith, and of the hushed, respectful manner people adopt before something sacred. A written, somewhat elevated word.

examples.japanese: {敬虔|けいけん}なクリスチャンだ。

⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{敬虔|けいけん}な{気持|きも}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仏壇|ぶつだん}→仏壇：07116_butsudan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
examples.english: Every morning my grandmother puts her hands together before the family altar in a reverent spirit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参拝者|さんぱいしゃ}→参拝者：21620_sanpaisha⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{敬虔|けいけん}な{面持|おもも}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{本殿|ほんでん}→本殿：13090_honden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げた→下げる：00807_sageru⟧。
examples.english: The worshippers stood before the main shrine with reverent expressions and quietly bowed their heads.

notes:
Chiefly written and formal; in speech, ⟦{信心深|しんじんぶか}い→信心深い：30677_shinjinbukai⟧ is the everyday equivalent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敬虔|けいけん}な⟦{信者|しんじゃ}→信者：11565_shinja⟧: a devout believer
- {敬虔|けいけん}な⟦{祈|いの}り→祈り：13732_inori⟧: a devout prayer
- {敬虔|けいけん}な{気持|きも}ち: a reverent frame of mind
- {敬虔|けいけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧: to pray reverently

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{信心深|しんじんぶか}い→信心深い：30677_shinjinbukai⟧: devout — the plain, conversational word
- ⟦{厳|おごそ}か→厳か：11864_ogosoka⟧: solemn — describes the atmosphere of a ceremony rather than a person's faith
